title: 羊倔倔
description:
Prompt: Character design sheet of a 3D cartoon white goat IP, character sheet with multiple views: front view, side profile, back view, and 3/4 view.
Features: A very exaggerated big pink nose showing strong perspective, widely spaced eyes with a slightly derpy and blank stare (eyes looking in different directions for a subtle comedic effect). A slight smirk on the mouth, with a piece of green grass always hanging out of the corner of the mouth. Messy, fluffy, white curly fur, large floppy ears, small curved horns. Chubby body with short legs. Cute, soft, and a little bit silly.
Style: Pixar 3D style, soft rendering, fluffy fur texture, high detail, clean white background. High recognition.
